title: TikTok Video Downloader — Safe Public Video Saving
description: Validate a public TikTok video URL and review rights-aware download options with rate limits, temporary processing and automatic cleanup.
intro: Validate a public TikTok video URL, preview its identity and review safe download options. Only save content you own or have permission to use.

useCases.title: Save your own published media
useCases.description: Validate the canonical URL for a public video you created before requesting an eligible temporary download.

useCases.title: Handle licensed campaign assets
useCases.description: Use a rights-confirmed workflow when a creator has explicitly authorized a marketer to retain a campaign deliverable.

useCases.title: Verify a video before processing
useCases.description: Reject profile pages, unrelated domains and malformed identifiers before any media-source request is attempted.

examples.title: Accepted canonical video URL
examples.description: A full HTTPS tiktok.com/@creator/video/123 URL can proceed to identity validation and rights confirmation.

examples.title: Rejected profile or short link
examples.description: A creator profile, non-video TikTok path or unapproved redirect host is rejected instead of being treated as downloadable media.

tips.title: Confirm ownership or permission
tips.description: Technical availability never replaces copyright, creator consent or the license needed for reuse.

tips.title: Inspect the preview identity
tips.description: Check the creator and video identifier before choosing any download option or storing a campaign asset.

tips.title: Expect temporary delivery
tips.description: Validated media expires quickly and successful delivery consumes the temporary server copy rather than creating a library.

faqDescription: Accepted URLs, rights boundaries, temporary retention and download availability.

faq.question: What URLs does the TikTok video downloader accept?
faq.answer: The validator accepts full HTTPS TikTok video URLs such as tiktok.com/@creator/video/123. Profile pages, short links and other domains are rejected.

faq.question: Can I save any TikTok video?
faq.answer: No. You should only save content you own or have explicit permission to use. Availability can also be limited by privacy, removal, regional or platform restrictions.

faq.question: Does TokLens keep downloaded videos?
faq.answer: No. Permanent user-media storage is prohibited. Validated media can only use temporary processing storage, expires within 15 minutes and is removed after delivery.

faq.question: Why are download options currently unavailable?
faq.answer: TokLens enables downloads only after a verified media source and the returned bytes pass every security check. The current preview validates the video URL without scraping or inventing a media file.

faq.question: How does TokLens protect the download service?
faq.answer: The service uses a TikTok domain whitelist, HTTPS-only URLs, request limits, small JSON request bodies, MP4 file signatures, size limits, random temporary filenames and cleanup controls.

ui.safetyTitle: Temporary processing, never a media library
ui.safetyDescription: TokLens does not permanently store user media, bypass private content controls or fetch arbitrary URLs. Download delivery remains disabled until a verified media source passes every file check.

safetyControls.title: TikTok-only URL whitelist
safetyControls.description: Only full HTTPS video URLs on tiktok.com and approved subdomains pass validation.

safetyControls.title: Request rate limits
safetyControls.description: Preview requests are limited per anonymized client identifier to reduce abuse.

safetyControls.title: File validation
safetyControls.description: Media must pass MIME type, declared length, size and MP4 signature checks.

safetyControls.title: Isolated temporary storage
safetyControls.description: Validated bytes use random server-generated names and restricted file permissions.

safetyControls.title: Short retention
safetyControls.description: Temporary media expires after a maximum of 15 minutes.

safetyControls.title: Automatic cleanup
safetyControls.description: Expired files are removed and successful delivery consumes the temporary copy.
